book.name: ʻIsaia
book.title: KO E TOHI ʻAE PALŌFITA KO ʻISAIA

content: ‌ʻI he taʻu naʻe pekia ai ʻae tuʻi ko ʻUsia ne u mamata kia Sihova ʻoku ʻafio ʻi hono ʻafioʻanga, kuo māʻolunga mo hiki hake, pea ko hono kofu tōtōlofa naʻe fonu ai ʻae falelotu lahi.
Pea naʻe tuʻu ʻi ʻolunga ʻae Selafimi: naʻe taki ono hona kapakau; naʻa ne fakapulou ʻaki hono mata ʻae ua, pea ne ʻufiʻufi ʻaki hono vaʻe ʻae ua, pea ne puna ʻaki ʻae ua.
Pea naʻa na lea fetāliaki, ʻo pehē,

content.text: “ʻOku māʻoniʻoni, ʻoku māʻoniʻoni, ʻoku māʻoniʻoni, ʻa Sihova ʻoe ngaahi kautau:
ʻoku fonu ʻa māmani kotoa pē ʻi hono nāunau.”

content: Pea naʻe ngaueue ʻae ngaahi pou ʻoe matapā ʻi he leʻo ʻo ia naʻe ui, pea naʻe fakafonu ʻae fale ʻi he ʻohuafi.

¶ Pea ne u toki pehē, “Kuo u malaʻia au! He kuo u ʻauha; koeʻuhi ko e tangata loungutu taʻemaʻa au, pea ʻoku ou nofo ʻi he lotolotonga ʻoe kakai loungutu taʻemaʻa: he kuo mamata ʻa hoku mata ki he Tuʻi, ko Sihova ʻoe ngaahi kautau.”
Pea naʻe toki puna mai ʻae tokotaha ʻoe Selafimi kiate au, naʻe ʻi hono nima ʻae malalaʻi afi, ʻaia naʻa ne toʻo ʻaki ʻae hikofi mei he feilaulauʻanga.
Pea naʻa ne ai ia ki hoku ngutu, mo ne pehē, “Vakai kuo tau ʻae meʻa ni ki ho loungutu; pea kuo toʻo ʻo ʻave hoʻo hia, pea kuo fakamaʻa hoʻo angahala.”
Pea ne u fanongo foki ki he leʻo ʻo Sihova, naʻe pehē, “Ko hai te u fekau, pea ko hai ʻe ʻalu maʻamautolu?” Pea ne u toki pehē, “Ko au eni; ke ke fekau au.”
¶ Pea naʻa ne pehē, “ʻAlu, pea tala ki he kakai ni,

content.text: ʻOku mou fanongo moʻoni,
kae ʻikai ongoʻi;
pea ʻoku mou mamata pau,
kae ʻikai ʻiloʻi.
Ngaohi ke fangapesi ʻae loto ʻoe kakai ni,
pea ngaohi ke mamafa honau telinga,
pea tāpuni honau mata;
telia naʻa nau mamata ʻaki honau mata,
pea fanongo ʻaki honau telinga,
pea ʻilo ʻaki honau loto,
pea liliu, pea hoko ʻo moʻui.”
Pea ne u toki pehē, “ʻE Sihova, ʻe fēfē hono fuoloa?”
“Ke ʻoua ke lala ʻae ngaahi kolo ʻo ʻikai ha tokotaha ke nofo ai,
pea ʻikai ha tangata ʻi he ngaahi fale,
pea lala ʻaupito ʻae fonua,
Pea ke ʻoua ke ʻave ʻe Sihova ʻae kakai,
pea hoko ʻae liʻaki lahi ki he fonua.
Ka e ʻi ai ʻae vahe ʻe hongofulu,
pea ʻe toe foki ia, pea ʻe keina ia;
ka e hangē ko e ʻakau ko e teili, pea hangē ko e oke, ʻoka tā hifo ʻoku kei tuʻu hono aka:
ʻe pehē ʻe hoko ʻae hako māʻoniʻoni ko e aka ʻoe puleʻanga.”
